## Agenda Item Detail

### Item 2: Project Charter Walkthrough
Cover:
- Project purpose and problem statement
- Scope: what's in, what's explicitly out
- Objectives and success criteria (business-level Definition of Done)
- Key milestones and target dates
- Budget authorization summary
- Authority and decision rights

**Expected outcome:** All attendees share the same understanding of scope and objectives.

### Item 3: Scope Clarification Q&A
Facilitator prompts:
- "Is there anything in scope that you expected to NOT be included?"
- "Is there anything not in scope that you expected to be included?"
- "Are there any dependencies or integration points we haven't mentioned?"

**Parking lot:** Items raised that need further investigation go here, not into scope immediately.

### Item 4: Team Roles & RACI
- Walk through who is Responsible / Accountable / Consulted / Informed for each major decision type
- Confirm client contact names and their sign-off authority
- Confirm escalation path

### Item 5: Tools, Channels & Access
- Project tracker: {Jira / Linear / Notion / etc.} — link: {URL}
- Communication: {Slack / Teams / email} — channel: {#channel-name}
- Repository: {GitHub / GitLab} — link: {URL}
- Documents: {Google Drive / Confluence / Notion} — link: {URL}
- Design files: {Figma} — link: {URL}
- CI/CD / Deployment: {Platform} — link: {URL}

**Action:** PM to ensure all attendees have access before meeting. Confirm live during this item.

### Item 6: Working Agreements
Team agrees on:
- Sprint cadence: {Weekly / Biweekly}
- Standup: {Daily at HH:MM / Async in Slack}
- Sprint review / demo: {Day, time}
- Retrospective: {Cadence}
- Response time expectation: {e.g. Same business day for Slack, 24h for email}
- Definition of Done for individual tasks: {e.g. Code reviewed, tests passing, deployed to staging}
- Change request process: {Who to contact, how much lead time}

### Item 7: Next Steps & Action Items
PM captures action items live in the table below.
